title: Grid snapping
description:
Snap positions to a grid and select objects with a rubber-band rectangle.

```
grid 16: (23, 41) -> (16, 48)
drag from (10, 10) to (60, 40): selects 2 objects
drag backwards from (60, 40) to (10, 10): same 2 objects
```
hints: `min = {std::min(a.x, b.x), std::min(a.y, b.y)}` and the same with `max` normalise the rectangle.
requirements: `snap(value, grid)` rounds to the nearest multiple.
The selection rectangle works in any drag direction (normalise it).
An object is selected when its centre is inside.
stretch: Hold Shift to add to the selection and Ctrl to toggle.
